parsed.note_claim: SynthID is a kind of digital watermark that embeds invisible information in images, audio, and video, and image SynthID is robust to edits and recompression.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: SynthID adds an invisible digital watermark to an AI-generated image (or video segment). The watermark doesn’t change the image or video quality. It’s added the moment content is created, and designed to stand up to modifications like cropping, adding filters, changing frame rates, or lossy compression.
parsed.reason: The page directly describes SynthID as an imperceptible watermark in images, audio and video that is designed to survive modifications like lossy compression, and notes OpenAI as a partner whose content the detector can check.
